0022600174.text: The Wizards (4-3, first in the Southeast and sixth in the East, on a two-game winning streak) host the Atlanta Hawks (4-4, second in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, and seventh in the East, on a one-game winning streak) in the eighth game of Washington's season. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman, and Tristan Vukcevic, and Alex Sarr and Anthony Gill are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar, Jock Landale, and Mouhamed Gueye, and Jalen Johnson is day-to-day with an ankle injury and also a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 126-96 defeat in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
